title: Closing settings when a report/child page is open must use the back handler
answers: Settings close button does nothing when a report is open inside settings
Escape vs close button behave differently in settings
How does dismissing settings work with child routes?
body:
In `SettingsLayout`, `back` is defined only when `children` exist (a page opened inside settings, on its own route); it either pushes `childBackHref` (preserving `tabId`) or `navigateToSettings(category)`.
- `dismiss = back ?? closeSettings` feeds the close button and backdrop click (`onDismiss`/`onClose`); `onEscape={back}` and `onBack` use the same handler.
- Calling `closeSettings()` from a child route breaks because there is no settings route to leave.
- `SettingsPanel` no longer owns Escape; the Escape hotkey lives in `SettingsDialogFrame` (search input still clears its query on first Escape).
